answer: Audits are recorded in atlas, queued in quill, and yarrow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 45 identities per epoch. A farm of 314 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3684 identities would post 4537 proofs and burn roughly 65 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
